# tools/

<!-- GENERATED by tools/gen_readme.py — do not hand-edit. Run `python tools/gen_readme.py` after changing a tool's TOOL_META. -->

Helper scripts for this integration, grouped by domain. Each tool also prints its domain/run-by/when on `--help`.

**Run by:** 🤖 `ci` runs automatically in CI (you rarely invoke by hand) · 👤 `owner` you run for debugging/fact-finding · 🔧 `maintainer` repo-specific.

## `inventory/`

Fact-discipline gates — keep inventory.yaml / entity-inventory.yaml / docs honest.

### `python tools/inventory/audit_outstanding_retractions.py`  —  🤖 ci

List inventory retractions that lack a re-verified replacement claim.

*When:* Every CI build (notice-only); when reviewing retraction debt.

### `python tools/inventory/entity_inventory_audit.py`  —  🤖 ci

Verify entity-inventory.yaml covers every integration entity class.

*When:* Every CI build; after adding or changing an entity.

### `python tools/inventory/inventory_audit.py`  —  🤖 ci

Cross-check inventory.yaml for internal contradictions and value-catalog gaps.

*When:* Every CI build; locally before shipping a fact-heavy change.

### `python tools/inventory/inventory_gen.py`  —  🤖 ci

Generate canonical inventory docs from inventory.yaml and validate its schema.

*When:* Every CI build (--validate-only); locally before shipping an inventory change.

### `python tools/inventory/journal_completeness_check.py`  —  👤 owner

Flag research-journal paragraphs that were never folded into inventory.yaml.

*When:* When auditing the research journal for analysis not promoted into inventory.yaml.

### `python tools/inventory/wire_census.py`  —  👤 owner

Regenerate docs/research/wire-census.json and report wire values missing from inventory.

*When:* After a new probe capture lands, to regenerate the wire census and find unparked values.

## `probes/`

Device & cloud probes for owner fact-finding. Some WRITE to the live mower.

### `python tools/probes/inventory_probe.py`  —  👤 owner

Read-only Dreame-cloud probe that dumps device properties for inventory verification.

*When:* When verifying an inventory claim against live cloud property values (read-only).

### `python tools/probes/oss_photo_probe.py`  —  👤 owner

Probe get_interim_file_url vs get_file_url for a photo_list OSS key.

*When:* When verifying which OSS signing endpoint resolves a photo key. Read-only.

### `python tools/probes/probe_add_maintenance_point.py`  —  👤 owner

Probe candidate map-edit payloads for adding a maintenance point.

*When:* When reverse-engineering maintenance-point map edits. WRITES to the live device.

### `python tools/probes/probe_cruise_to_point.py`  —  👤 owner

Probe candidate cruise-to-point command payload shapes on the live g2408.

*When:* When reverse-engineering cruise-to-point (op=109) payloads. WRITES to the live device.

### `python tools/probes/probe_pre_write.py`  —  👤 owner

Probe whether CFG.PRE is writable on the g2408 vs cloud-cache-only.

*When:* When testing whether CFG.PRE (mowing efficiency) is device-writable. WRITES to the live device.

## `state_machine/`

Entity-source / state-machine audit (run after coordinator or entity changes).

### `python tools/state_machine/state_machine_audit.py`  —  👤 owner

Audit how every entity sources its value (sourcing/idle/reboot/orphan-field checks).

*When:* When verifying entity value-source wiring after coordinator/entity changes.

## `session/`

Reconstruct or verify session archives from probe logs (dev box).

### `python tools/session/rebuild_session.py`  —  👤 owner

End-to-end rebuild of a session archive from MQTT probe logs.

*When:* When reconstructing a session archive from probe logs (dev box only).

### `python tools/session/state_partition.py`  —  👤 owner

Check a session JSON's time partition against probe-log evidence.

*When:* When verifying a session archive's time breakdown against probe-log ground truth.

## `release/`

Maintainer-only HACS publishing for this repo. Not general-purpose.

### `tools/release/promote-latest.sh`  —  🔧 maintainer

Force the highest-version release to be marked Latest (not prerelease).

*When:* When GitHub demoted the newest release off "Latest".

### `tools/release/release.sh`  —  🔧 maintainer

Bump version, tag, push, create the GitHub Release, and refresh HACS.

*When:* After pushing integration commits, to cut a HACS-visible release.
